caption: The drawing depicts a single translucent glass bowl with a wide, shallow, circular dish at the top, narrowing down to a stem, and ending in a flat, round base. The glass is colored in shades of greenish-blue, with subtle white highlights and reflections that accentuate the smooth, curved surfaces. There are three oval, slightly raised areas on the inner surface of the bowl, and faint, swirling lines suggesting texture or reflections in the glass. The background is a plain beige color, and there is a faint rectangular border drawn around the image. The bowl is centered and shown in a three-quarters view, providing a clear view of both its interior and exterior surfaces.
